summary.intent: Resolve all open review comment threads on PR #548 by triaging each comment, implementing valid fixes, and replying/resolving each thread.
summary.outcome: One thread (greptile P1 on init script file mode) was determined not applicable after verifying Kubo source; one thread (coderabbit doc update on resource caps) was fixed in DEVELOPMENT.md and committed after recovering accidentally deleted scripts.

repo: Kubo v0.42.0 container_init_run sources non-executable scripts ('. $script') rather than skipping them — 100644 mode on docker/ipfs-init/*.sh is intentional and correct.
Actual docker-compose resource caps: ipfs=3G/1.5CPU, someguy=2G/1.0CPU — DEVELOPMENT.md previously documented both as 2G/1CPU.
The pre-commit hook calls ./scripts/check-api-client.sh; if that script is missing from the working tree the entire commit is blocked.

code.finding: Resource cap table was stale; corrected to ipfs 3G/1.5CPU and someguy 2G/1.0CPU to match docker-compose values.
Committed as 100644 (non-executable) intentionally — Kubo sources it rather than executes it, so the mode is correct.

workflow: Greptile P1 severity claims should always be verified against upstream source before acting — the P1 here was incorrect.
Fetching the actual upstream binary (container_init_run) was necessary to authoritatively resolve the file-mode question; documentation alone was insufficient.
Branch switching can silently drop tracked files as unstaged deletions (D in git status), breaking pre-commit hooks that invoke those scripts.

friction: Pre-commit hook failed because 6 tracked scripts were missing from the working tree (shown as unstaged deletions), likely dropped during earlier branch switches — required git restore before commit could proceed.
Kubo's container_daemon script delegates to container_init_run as a separate executable, requiring two fetches to trace the actual sourcing logic.
open_items: PR #550 has 4 unresolved review threads — the session only resolved #548 and did not address #550.
Root cause of 6 tracked scripts disappearing during branch switches was not investigated; could recur.
